title: A Sausage Can Work Your Touchscreen
pause_note: Short format v3: 20-30 s, claim first, loop ending

beats: A sausage can work your touchscreen.
They sense a tiny electric field over the glass.
Anything that conducts, like a finger or a sausage, disturbs that field where it touches.
A wool glove doesn't conduct, so the screen can't see it.
Your screen feels electricity, not touch.
